text: The change disables the global save key and handles KeyS in the mail-window keypress listener. Exactly one of Control and Meta is required, Alt is excluded and Shift is not filtered. The contentTab branch prevents default behavior, tries PDFJS:Save and returns even when actor lookup or messaging throws. The actual content-tab type accepts general URLs; the branch has no PDF check or message-save fallback. Other modes use cmd_saveAsFile. No live keyboard or non-PDF save result was tested.
title: The save key routes every content tab through the PDF actor without a fallback
